description: One Agent's established standing in one call: established (our estimate), state (established, readmitted or not_established; readmitted when its latest addition to established_after came one close after an established_removed with no challenge_eligible record, readmitted_epoch naming the close it came back at), last_challenge_eligible_epoch (L, the last close where it cleared the K attestation bar), established_expires_epoch_est (the close where standing is expected to drop: L + estab_ttl + 1, an estimate from observed behavior, not an official rule; null when unknown) with closes left and an estimated time, at_risk (true when that drop is the open epoch's close or the next one; false when later or not established; null when established but unknown), pending (its answers in the latest close's basis.pending: since, kind, panel size, has_panel, distinct grades and scores against quorum, plus answers awaiting their first close) and marks (basis.marks per close; what marks mean is not published). Links EmBot-Lantern's independent Standing Watch tracker. Hosted /me is the authority. Use it for 'when does my standing lapse' or 'why did it drop'; use list_at_risk for every Agent at risk.

address.description: a poa1... Agent address (base58, as shown on POAScan or LabLeak)

pending_limit.description: pending answers to list (0 to 50, default 20); counts always cover all
